sentences.s: There will eventually come a day when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint.

components.原文: There will eventually come a day
components.中文翻译: 终将有一天到来
components.说明: there引导的存在句式倒装，真正主语a day后置于谓语will come之后。

components.原文: when The New York Times ceases to publish stories on newsprint
components.中文翻译: 《纽约时报》不再用新闻纸印刷报道（的那一天）
components.说明: when引导定语从句修饰先行词day，when在从句中作时间状语。

components.原文: to publish stories on newsprint
components.中文翻译: 用新闻纸印刷报道
components.说明: 动词不定式作cease的宾语/补足成分，on newsprint为介词短语作方式状语。

sentences.zh: 终将有一天，《纽约时报》会不再用新闻纸印刷报道。

sentences.s: Exactly when that day will be is a matter of debate.

trunk.主语: Exactly when that day will be

components.原文: Exactly when that day will be
components.中文翻译: 那一天究竟会是什么时候
components.说明: when引导的主语从句，整体作句子主语，Exactly为强调副词。

sentences.zh: 那一天究竟会在何时到来，是一个有争议的问题。

sentences.s: "Sometime in the future," the paper's publisher said back in 2010.

trunk.主干翻译: 该报的出版人说"未来某个时候"。

components.原文: back in 2010
components.中文翻译: 早在2010年
components.说明: 时间状语，修饰said，交代说话时间。

sentences.zh: "未来的某个时候，"该报出版人早在2010年就这样说过。

sentences.s: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside, there's plenty of incentive to ditch print.

components.原文: Nostalgia for ink on paper and the rustle of pages aside
components.中文翻译: 撇开对纸上油墨和翻页沙沙声的怀念不谈
components.说明: aside构成独立结构作让步性插入语，置于句首。

components.原文: ink on paper and the rustle of pages
components.中文翻译: 纸上的油墨和翻页的沙沙声
components.说明: and连接两个并列的介词宾语，均为Nostalgia for的怀念对象。

components.原文: to ditch print
components.中文翻译: 放弃纸质印刷的
components.说明: 动词不定式作后置定语，修饰incentive。

sentences.zh: 撇开对纸上油墨和翻页沙沙声的怀念不谈，放弃纸质印刷有着大量充足的理由。

sentences.s: The infrastructure required to make a physical newspaper—printing presses, delivery trucks—isn't just expensive; it's excessive at a time when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints.

trunk.主干翻译: 基础设施不仅昂贵；它还过度奢侈。

components.原文: required to make a physical newspaper
components.中文翻译: 制作一份实体报纸所需要的
components.说明: 过去分词短语作后置定语修饰infrastructure。

components.原文: to make a physical newspaper
components.中文翻译: 制作一份实体报纸
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，承接required，表示为何而需要。

components.原文: printing presses, delivery trucks
components.中文翻译: 印刷机、运货卡车
components.说明: 破折号间的同位语，举例说明infrastructure的具体内容，作插入成分。

components.原文: when online-only competitors don't have the same set of financial constraints
components.中文翻译: 纯线上竞争对手没有同样一套财务约束（的时候）
components.说明: when引导定语从句修饰先行词time，when在从句中作时间状语。

sentences.zh: 制作一份实体报纸所需的基础设施——印刷机、运货卡车——不仅昂贵，而且在纯线上竞争对手并不受同样一套财务约束的当下，它更显得过度奢侈。

sentences.s: Readers are migrating away from print anyway.

components.原文: away from print
components.中文翻译: 远离纸质版
components.说明: 介词短语作方向状语，修饰migrating；anyway为语气副词，意为"无论如何"。

sentences.zh: 无论如何，读者们正在不断地远离纸质版报纸。

sentences.s: And though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts, revenue from print is still declining.

components.原文: though print ad sales still dwarf their online and mobile counterparts
components.中文翻译: 尽管纸质广告销售额仍使其线上和移动端的同类相形见绌
components.说明: though引导让步状语从句，dwarf意为"使相形见绌"。

components.原文: from print
components.中文翻译: 来自纸质版的
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语，修饰revenue。

sentences.zh: 尽管纸质广告的销售额仍让其线上和移动端的同类相形见绌，但来自纸质版的收入仍在持续下降。

sentences.s: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake, says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti.

trunk.主干翻译: BuzzFeed首席执行官乔纳·佩雷蒂说……

components.原文: Overhead may be high and circulation lower, but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake
components.中文翻译: 管理费用可能很高、发行量可能更低，但匆忙取消其纸质版会是一个错误
components.说明: 前置的宾语从句，句尾says BuzzFeed CEO Jonah Peretti为倒装的引述。

components.原文: Overhead may be high and circulation lower
components.中文翻译: 管理费用可能很高，发行量可能更低
components.说明: and连接两个并列分句，后一分句省略may be。

components.原文: but rushing to eliminate its print edition would be a mistake
components.中文翻译: 但匆忙取消其纸质版会是个错误
components.说明: but引导转折并列分句，动名词rushing...作主语。

components.原文: to eliminate its print edition
components.中文翻译: 取消其纸质版
components.说明: 不定式承接rushing，说明匆忙去做的具体事情。

sentences.zh: BuzzFeed首席执行官乔纳·佩雷蒂说，管理费用可能很高、发行量可能更低，但匆忙取消其纸质版将会是一个错误。

sentences.s: Peretti says the Times shouldn't waste time getting out of the print business, but only if they go about doing it the right way.

components.原文: the Times shouldn't waste time getting out of the print business, but only if they go about doing it the right way
components.中文翻译: 《纽约时报》不应在退出纸质业务上浪费时间，但前提是他们以正确的方式去做
components.说明: say的宾语从句，省略了that。

components.原文: getting out of the print business
components.中文翻译: 退出纸质业务（这件事上）
components.说明: 动名词短语，承接waste time，说明在何事上浪费时间。

components.原文: but only if they go about doing it the right way
components.中文翻译: 但前提是他们以正确的方式去做
components.说明: but连接的转折并列成分，对前句加以限定。

components.原文: if they go about doing it the right way
components.中文翻译: 如果他们以正确的方式去做的话
components.说明: if引导条件状语从句，only强调唯一条件。

components.原文: doing it the right way
components.中文翻译: 以正确的方式去做这件事
components.说明: go about doing固定搭配，动名词作go about的宾语。

sentences.zh: 佩雷蒂说，《纽约时报》不应在退出纸质业务上浪费时间，但前提是他们要以正确的方式去做。

sentences.s: "Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition would make sense for them," he said, "but if you discontinue it, you're going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you."

trunk.谓语: would make / are going to have
trunk.主干翻译: 想出一个办法会有意义；但如果停掉，你会让顾客很不满。

components.原文: Figuring out a way to accelerate that transition
components.中文翻译: 想出一个加速那种转变的办法
components.说明: 动名词短语作前一分句主语（归入此节点说明）。

components.原文: to accelerate that transition
components.中文翻译: 加速那种转变的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰way。

components.原文: but if you discontinue it, you're going to have your most loyal customers really upset with you
components.中文翻译: 但如果你停掉它，你会让你最忠实的顾客对你非常不满
components.说明: but连接的转折并列分句。

components.原文: if you discontinue it
components.中文翻译: 如果你把它停掉
components.说明: if引导条件状语从句，修饰主句going to have。

components.原文: to have your most loyal customers really upset with you
components.中文翻译: 让你最忠实的顾客对你非常不满
components.说明: be going to后的不定式，构成将来时谓语。

components.原文: your most loyal customers really upset with you
components.中文翻译: 你最忠实的顾客对你非常不满
components.说明: have的复合宾语（宾语+宾补upset），此处按提示归为宾语成分。

sentences.zh: 他说："想出一个办法来加速那种转变，对他们是有意义的，但如果你直接停掉它，你就会让你最忠实的顾客对你非常不满。"

sentences.s: Sometimes that's worth making a change anyway.

components.原文: making a change
components.中文翻译: 做出改变
components.说明: 动名词作worth的宾语，构成worth doing结构；Sometimes、anyway为状语副词。

sentences.zh: 有时候，无论如何那也值得去做出改变。

sentences.s: Peretti gives the example of Netflix discontinuing its DVD–mailing service to focus on streaming.

components.原文: of Netflix discontinuing its DVD–mailing service
components.中文翻译: 网飞停止其DVD邮寄服务的
components.说明: of介词短语作后置定语，Netflix为动名词discontinuing的逻辑主语。

components.原文: to focus on streaming
components.中文翻译: 以专注于流媒体
components.说明: 不定式作目的状语，说明停止服务的目的。

sentences.zh: 佩雷蒂举了网飞为专注于流媒体而停止其DVD邮寄服务的例子。

sentences.s: "It was seen as a blunder," he said.

components.原文: It was seen as a blunder
components.中文翻译: 它被视为一个失误
components.说明: 前置的直接引语作said的宾语，be seen as意为"被看作"。

sentences.zh: "它当时被看作是一个失误，"他说。

sentences.s: The move turned out to be foresighted.

trunk.主干翻译: 这一举措结果证明是有远见的。

components.原文: to be foresighted
components.中文翻译: 是有远见的
components.说明: 不定式作turn out的补足成分，构成turn out to be结构。

sentences.zh: 事实证明，这一举措是颇有远见的。

sentences.s: And if Peretti were in charge at the Times?

components.原文: if Peretti were in charge at the Times
components.中文翻译: 如果佩雷蒂在《纽约时报》掌管大局
components.说明: if引导虚拟条件状语从句，were表虚拟语气；全句为省略主句的疑问设问。

sentences.zh: 那么，假如佩雷蒂在《纽约时报》掌管大局，他会怎么做呢？

sentences.s: "I wouldn't pick a year to end print," he said.

components.原文: I wouldn't pick a year to end print
components.中文翻译: 我不会挑定某一年来终结纸质版
components.说明: 前置的直接引语作said的宾语。

components.原文: to end print
components.中文翻译: 终结纸质版的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰year。

sentences.zh: "我不会挑定某一年来终结纸质版，"他说。

sentences.s: "I would raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product."

trunk.主干翻译: 我会提高价格，并把它变成更具传承意味的产品。

components.原文: raise prices and make it into more of a legacy product
components.中文翻译: 提高价格并把它变成更像传承遗产的产品
components.说明: and连接两个并列谓语raise和make，共用主语I would。

sentences.zh: "我会提高价格，并把它变成更具传承意味的产品。"

sentences.s: The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in.

trunk.主干翻译: 最忠实的顾客仍能得到他们喜爱的产品，而且他们会觉得……

components.原文: they favor
components.中文翻译: 他们喜爱的
components.说明: 省略关系代词that的定语从句修饰product。

components.原文: the idea goes
components.中文翻译: 这种想法是这样的
components.说明: 插入语，表明这是一种设想/说法。

components.原文: and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in
components.中文翻译: 并且他们会感觉自己在帮助维持他们所信赖之物的品质
components.说明: and连接的并列分句。

components.原文: like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in
components.中文翻译: 好像自己正在帮助维持他们所信赖之物的品质
components.说明: like引导方式状语从句（口语中相当于as if），修饰feel。

components.原文: sustain the quality of something they believe in
components.中文翻译: 维持他们所信赖之物的品质
components.说明: help后省略to的动词原形，作helping的宾语。

components.原文: they believe in
components.中文翻译: 他们所信赖的
components.说明: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰something。

sentences.zh: 按这种设想，最忠实的顾客仍能得到他们喜爱的产品，而且他们会觉得自己是在帮助维系自己所信赖之物的品质。

sentences.s: "So if you're overpaying for print, you could feel like you were helping," Peretti said.

components.原文: if you're overpaying for print
components.中文翻译: 如果你为纸质版多付了钱
components.说明: if引导条件状语从句，修饰主句could feel。

components.原文: like you were helping
components.中文翻译: 好像你正在出一份力
components.说明: like引导方式状语从句（相当于as if），修饰feel。

sentences.zh: "所以，如果你为纸质版多付了钱，你会感觉自己是在帮忙出力，"佩雷蒂说。

sentences.s: "Then increase it at a higher rate each year and essentially try to generate additional revenue."

trunk.主干翻译: 然后（你）逐年以更高幅度涨价，本质上设法创造额外收入。

components.原文: increase it at a higher rate each year and essentially try to generate additional revenue
components.中文翻译: 每年以更高的幅度涨价，并实质上设法创造额外的收入
components.说明: and连接两个并列祈使谓语increase和try。

components.原文: to generate additional revenue
components.中文翻译: 去创造额外的收入
components.说明: 不定式作try的宾语，构成try to do结构。

sentences.zh: "然后每年以更高的幅度涨价，本质上就是设法创造额外的收入。"

sentences.s: In other words, if you're going to make a print product, make it for the people who are already obsessed with it.

components.原文: if you're going to make a print product
components.中文翻译: 如果你打算做一款纸质产品
components.说明: if引导条件状语从句，修饰主句祈使句make it。

components.原文: to make a print product
components.中文翻译: 做一款纸质产品
components.说明: be going to后的不定式，构成将来意图。

components.原文: who are already obsessed with it
components.中文翻译: 已经对它痴迷的
components.说明: who引导定语从句修饰先行词people。

sentences.zh: 换句话说，如果你打算做一款纸质产品，那就为那些已经痴迷于它的人去做。

sentences.s: Which may be what the Times is doing already.

components.原文: what the Times is doing already
components.中文翻译: 《纽约时报》已经在做的事
components.说明: what引导表语从句，Which作关系代词承接上句内容引出本句。

sentences.zh: 而这或许正是《纽约时报》已经在做的事情。

sentences.s: Getting the print edition seven days a week costs nearly $500 a year—more than twice as much as a digital–only subscription.

trunk.主语: Getting the print edition seven days a week
trunk.主干翻译: 一周七天都订阅纸质版每年要花将近500美元。

components.原文: Getting the print edition seven days a week
components.中文翻译: 一周七天都获取纸质版
components.说明: 动名词短语作句子主语。

components.原文: more than twice as much as a digital–only subscription
components.中文翻译: 是纯数字版订阅费的两倍多
components.说明: 破折号后的补充说明，对前面金额作比较，挂靠$500。

sentences.zh: 一周七天都订阅纸质版，每年要花将近500美元——是纯数字版订阅费的两倍多。

sentences.s: "It's a really hard thing to do and it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business," Peretti remarked.

trunk.主干翻译: 这是一件很难做的事，而且是一种巨大的奢侈。

components.原文: to do
components.中文翻译: 做的
components.说明: 不定式作后置定语修饰thing，构成hard to do结构。

components.原文: it's a tremendous luxury that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business
components.中文翻译: BuzzFeed没有传统遗留业务是一种巨大的幸运
components.说明: and连接的并列分句，it为形式主语。

components.原文: that BuzzFeed doesn't have a legacy business
components.中文翻译: BuzzFeed没有传统遗留业务（这一点）
components.说明: that引导从句，解释luxury的具体内容，it为形式主语而此从句为真正主语，按提示归为说明luxury的内容性从句。

sentences.zh: "这是一件很难做的事，而BuzzFeed没有需要背负的传统遗留业务，这是一种巨大的幸运，"佩雷蒂评论道。

sentences.s: "But we're going to have questions like that where we have things we're doing that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes.

trunk.主干翻译: 我们将会遇到那样的问题。

components.原文: to have questions like that where we have things we're doing that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes
components.中文翻译: 遇到那样的问题，即我们在做一些当市场和世界发生变化时就变得不合理的事情
components.说明: be going to后的不定式构成将来时。

components.原文: where we have things we're doing that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes
components.中文翻译: 在其中我们做着一些（当市场和世界变化时）不合理的事情
components.说明: where引导定语从句修饰指代questions的that。

components.原文: we're doing
components.中文翻译: 我们正在做的
components.说明: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰things。

components.原文: that don't make sense when the market changes and the world changes
components.中文翻译: 当市场和世界变化时就变得没有意义的
components.说明: that引导定语从句修饰things。

components.原文: when the market changes and the world changes
components.中文翻译: 当市场和世界发生变化时
components.说明: when引导时间状语从句，修饰don't make sense。

components.原文: the market changes and the world changes
components.中文翻译: 市场变化、世界变化
components.说明: and连接时间从句内两个并列分句。

sentences.zh: "但我们将会遇到诸如此类的问题：我们做着一些事情，而当市场和世界发生变化时，这些事情就变得不合理了。"

sentences.s: In those situations, it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive."

trunk.主干翻译: 更明智的做法是更具进取心。

components.原文: to be more aggressive than less aggressive
components.中文翻译: 更具进取心而非畏缩保守
components.说明: 不定式作真正主语，it为形式主语；than引出比较。

components.原文: In those situations
components.中文翻译: 在那些情况下
components.说明: 介词短语作状语，置于句首交代条件背景。

sentences.zh: "在那些情况下，更具进取心要好过畏缩保守。"
